statement: A defect demonstrated on one signal was fixed on three others, because the card named the signals that looked clearest in source rather than the one the reproduction landed on. The mechanism was correct and the reasoning sound; it simply did not reach the instance. Before closing a card, re-run the reproduction that produced the defect against the candidate build and read the numbers — not the tests written alongside the fix, which necessarily exercise the signals the fix touched. A green suite over new fixtures is evidence the mechanism works; only the original reproduction is evidence the defect is closed.

A fix gated behind an opt-in configuration that is not the default fixes nobody until the default moves, and a changelog entry describing it without that sentence is a false assertion in the document a customer reads to decide whether to upgrade. Cejel's withheld-path abstention is gated to a prospective rubric; the calibrated public default still moves a score on a withheld file, and will until a recalibration nobody has scheduled. State the gate in the same paragraph as the fix, in the same voice, and say plainly what an unpinned run still does. Where the gate cannot be moved from the card that found the defect, record the options and recommend one; do not let the entry imply a decision the operator has not made.

Dropping an abstained component from a weighted score renormalizes the remaining weights, so abstaining can LOWER the aggregate it was meant to protect. Cejel abstains a signal whose input file it withheld under its own size ceiling; the criterion then scores from the surviving metrics, and where the abstained metric was the strongest — half the criterion's weight here — the criterion falls further than the silent under-count it replaced. The invariant said a self-imposed coverage limit never discounts a score; the mechanism written to honour it discounts one. Assert the numeric effect of an abstention, in both directions, against a control — presence of the abstention is not the property the invariant names.

A merge-review instrument's verdict predicate has to be satisfiable by the artifact it reads, and nobody checks that until it matters. Cejel's oversize reproduction printed FIXED only when the abstaining run's criterion score EQUALLED the control's and the criterion carried an insufficientData flag — but an abstained criterion scores zero by construction and the report schema emits no such field, so the branch was unreachable on every possible input and the script could only ever print NOT FIXED or UNCLEAR. Before relying on an instrument's verdict line, derive by hand one input that would make each branch fire; a predicate no artifact can satisfy reads exactly like a defect that will not die.
